archetype: JSON-LD articleBody repeating the protected prose
notes: The marked clause carries $84.6M and a JSON-LD payload repeats it. HEO transforms the clause and leaves the payload alone: its mechanisms are rendering tricks and a script payload is not rendered, so there is nothing to apply. The document exists to hold that limit visible — a publisher who marks a figure their own structured data republishes has published it, and HEO neither rewrites that nor complains about it.
